content: Just got to work at Northbridge Acoustics Institute, it's pouring here in Bergenfield today.
Updating my slides since I'm here as Acoustics Doctoral Researcher, Henrik Dahl is guiding my thesis and wants the new plots.
Could you nudge me later to prepare for our regular catch-up Tuesdays at 09:30, and check if Sofia Lindqvist who shares the bench with me has the calibration files?

Running between measurements today, remind Jonas Weber to save me a seat at the bench, he's the second person sharing the lab with me. Amara Okafor is the third person with me in there, ask her if the calibration finished.
Hi, three quick house rules: always use 24-hour clock for times, keep status summaries to three bullets max, and ask me before emailing FjordSonics Ltd.

Milo Renner is helping me with the tank setup this morning, he looks after all our lab equipment. Also I'm doing analysis for Project EchoDune later, that's the codename for my thesis work, so keep time free.
Project ReefPulse needs a quick check this afternoon, it's the codename for my other project. And please flag that abstracts for the conference are due 2026-11-20, I can't miss that.
Hi, could you check train options to Sorvik for EchoForum 2027? I want to lock in the presentation slides early.
Hi, I'm covering ACU-201 this term and the seminar meets Thursdays at 10:00, so please have the slides ready for me.
Our group gets together Fridays at 16:00, and you'll find me in the chamber in Hall C afterward.
Can you put lab safety training on my calendar for 2026-10-26 at 08:30?
I'll be down in Room 204 most of the afternoon getting the reverb measurements set up, and I've got the instruments reserved for Mondays at 13:00 so please nudge me beforehand.
Could you log that the mics we're setting up as Heron Array needed a new cable, and the vibrometer we call Wasp Probe was acting up again this morning?
Just checking the laptop before the meeting — I process everything in WaveSim 6.2 for signals and then move it over to EchoLab R2026a for the final analysis.
Could you check if the new recordings landed in /data/echodune/raw? I'm wrapping up calibrations and want everything copied over to /archive/echodune/v2 tonight.
I told everyone in #echo-lab-chat we'll start a bit late, and I'll share the tutorial slides in #acu201-tutors after lunch.
If anyone asks, I'll be by Ext 4471 this afternoon, and please tell the courier we're using Door 7B for deliveries.
For reference, our chamber procedure is: check calendar availability, reserve the slot online, log calibration data, notify the technician, then clean the chamber after.
Morning is hectic, could you nudge SonarTek Components about that delayed order? We get most parts through them, and maybe copy Petra Voss since she handles our sensors.
Quick check between tasks, I can't spend over 4,000 euros on equipment so flag anything higher, and the trip is covered up to 1,200 euros from the grant.
Heading to Kaldvik Harbor tomorrow for the field tests, then I'll do calibration over in Pier Building when I'm back.
I'll be working at my desk in Room 312 this morning, then going up to Room 405 to see my advisor before lunch.
Could you draft a quick update for Ingrid Solberg, who leads our department, and send the latest plots to Tomas Reyes, who is helping us from outside on this work?
Please add a task for me to submit the EchoForum abstract.
The team at FjordSonics Ltd. we're working with asked for our paperwork, so please include our ethics clearance EA-2026-084 when you reply.
Quick note, please log that the sonar prototype SN-114 is running on release Dataset v3.2 for today's comparison, thanks!
Running between meetings, just flagging journal club meets Wednesdays at 14:00 and safety training starts Mondays at 08:30 so I don't miss either.
For students dropping by, office hours are Tuesdays at 11:00, and you can pick up the handouts from the printer room in Hall B.
What's on my calendar on 2026-10-28?
Hi, can you keep this handy? I get in as esorensen01 these days, and I've been making room reservations via book.nai.example. Let me know if I mix them up!
Just updating my notes — the setup was calibrated on 2026-09-15 so I trust the readings, and I'm sending the full thesis text by 2027-03-01. It's a hectic stretch!
Can you remember that PrintHaus Nord is handling the poster order, and Lena Hauge agreed to talk at our group meeting? Thanks so much!
Quick pause between meetings — we're discussing SoundField Vol 44 tomorrow, and the funding paperwork went in under GR-8891, hopefully it clears soon.
NordFly Travel sorted my flights, which is a relief since we head out for fieldwork on 2026-11-05 and I have a packed day.
I dropped my things on Shelf K4 this morning, and I have Permit L-22 if I need to stay back late to finish up.
Can you remind me what I said earlier today about my faculty advisor name?
